brique._comment: Engine-native Reflexive family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: trace.inspect
objective.description: Inspect the local trace history through a request-scoped temporary projection.

#root.role: Build a temporary trace projection from local JSONL trace segments, query it in events or facets mode, and return the matching inspection payload.

mode._comment: Required. Accepted values: 'events' (returns ordered list of trace events), 'facets' (returns aggregated counts grouped by kind, cap, and ctx).

limit._comment: Optional. Maximum number of events to return. Applies to events mode only.

offset._comment: Optional. Zero-based event offset for pagination. Applies to events mode only.

order_by._comment: Optional. Sort order for events. Accepted values: 'ts_ns ASC' (oldest first), 'ts_ns DESC' (newest first, default).

include_payloads._comment: Optional. When true, includes full intention/response payloads in each event entry. Applies to events mode only.

filters._comment: Optional. Each key narrows the result set. Accepted keys: ctx_id (string — restrict to one context path), kind (string — restrict to one trace event kind), cap (string — restrict to one capacity name), intention_id (string — restrict to one intention chain).

time_range._comment: Optional. Time window to restrict scanned trace segments. Fields: from (string — RFC3339, required when time_range is present), to (string — RFC3339, required when time_range is present). Both fields are required together; providing only one is invalid.

events._comment: Present in events mode. Ordered list of trace events. Each event: { ts (string — RFC3339Nano timestamp), kind (string — trace event kind), cap (string — capacity name), ctx_id (string — context path), intention_id (string), payload (object — present only when include_payloads is true, contains raw intention and response JSON) }.

facets._comment: Present in facets mode. Aggregated occurrence counts. Keys: by_kind (object — maps trace kind to count), by_cap (object — maps capacity name to count), by_ctx (object — maps context path to count).

window_applied._comment: Present when a time_range was resolved. Echoes the effective bounds: { from (string — RFC3339), to (string — RFC3339) }.

diagnostics._comment: Present when the trace folder was accessible. Contains: { trace_folder (string — absolute path of the trace folder scanned) }.

effects.trace_projection: A request-scoped temporary SQLite projection is created in memory and discarded after the response.
effects.trace_segments: Local JSONL trace segment files are read from the current context trace folder.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local trace inspection request becomes either an ordered events list or aggregated facets counts over the selected local trace history, with timing and diagnostics.
invariants: trace.inspect is context-scoped: it reads only the local context trace folder, not parent or child contexts.
When time_range is absent, all available local trace segments are scanned.
When time_range is present, both 'from' and 'to' RFC3339 strings are required; providing only one is invalid.
Exactly one of events or facets is populated in the response, depending on the requested mode.
An empty trace folder is treated as a valid empty result, not as an error.
success: On success, returns either events or facets, together with duration_ms and diagnostics.
window_applied is included when a time_range was resolved.
failure: The capacity fails when mode is missing or not one of the accepted values.
The capacity fails when time_range is present but missing either 'from' or 'to'.
The capacity fails when limit, offset, or order_by have invalid formats.
The capacity fails when the local trace projection cannot be built or queried.
notes: The temporary projection is request-scoped and is not part of authoritative trace state.
include_payloads has no effect in facets mode.
